title: Chapter 243: Planning To Establish A Zerg Base

Chapter 243: Planning To Establish A Zerg Base

When a group of four-star Zerg hosts arrived, everyone noticed that there was a group of such flying soldiers in the Zerg army.

The Queen controlled the Zerg hosts, first discussed the specific distribution plan of the spoils with everyone, and then privately communicated with various races about the Zerg spoils trading.

Professionals were doing professional things, and Wu Qing and some of the real decision-makers of various races became idle.

At this time, a majestic bull lord with a bull head and a human body came towards Wu Qing.

"Respected Zerg lord! Bull lord Niu Chong has something to discuss, can we talk?"

Wu Qing had a good impression of the Bull Clan and readily agreed: "Of course!"

Wu Qing saw what Niu Chong was talking about and didn't want others to know, so he took Niu Chong away.

The two walked away from the crowd and strolled on the somewhat messy battlefield.

"My Niu tribe has been fighting on this battlefield for many years and has successfully controlled a city!"

"Unfortunately, the army of the Tianwai people suddenly entered this battlefield. Due to the special location of the city controlled by our tribe, it was attacked fiercely by the Tianwai people's army and has now been broken!"

"The tribe suffered heavy casualties, and I had to lead the surviving tribe members to retreat to the main city!"

"Due to the hasty retreat, some important items and a large amount of supplies of our tribe were not transported out in time, and now they all fell into the hands of the Tianwai people!"

"The nobles have just entered this battlefield. If you want to occupy a piece of land outside the main city, the city that our tribe once controlled is a good choice!"

"I have a lot of detailed information about that city and the surrounding areas, which can be provided free of charge!"

"I just hope that the nobles can kill more people from the Tianwai people! Revenge for my people!"

"If the nobles get things from my tribe from the spoils, I am willing to buy them back at a high price!"

As Niu Zhong said, he took out a large book of information organized into a strategy and handed it to Wu Qing.

Wu Qing did not speak. He took the information and flipped through it. He found several important information through the catalog.

After reading the information carefully, he felt that Niu Zhong was not lying. The city originally occupied by the Niu tribe was indeed a good place.

It was because of the importance of this place that it was treated specially by the Tianwai people. They directly organized a powerful army to break the city.

Wu Qing also understood Niu Zhong's thoughts. Facing the powerful Tianwai army, a battle to break the city, it can be imagined that the Niu tribe suffered heavy losses. With the temper of the Niu tribe, they must want revenge, but now their strength can no longer realize this wish.

Among the various ethnic armies in the local camp that surrounded the Tianwai army, the most fierce and tenacious one was the Niu army led by Niu Zhong. They were doing their best to avenge the Tianwai army.

Niu Zhong saw the strength of the Zerg army and believed that with the ability of the Zerg, they would never be willing to be trapped in the main city. They must open up territory outside, so they took the initiative to provide information.

Cities outside the main city can be seized by everyone, so the information in Niu Chong's hands is very valuable.

Niu Chong believes that being able to provide help to friendly forces and let friendly forces kill more enemies can also be regarded as revenge for the tribe.

If several important items that were lost can be found by the way, it will be an unexpected gain.

From the fact that Wu Qing was willing to take out all the spoils in his hand for exchange, he could see that the Zerg, who mainly evolved physically, did not value external objects. If several important items in the Niu tribe fell into the hands of the Zerg, there was still a chance to exchange them back.

In short, Niu Chong looked for Wu Qing for two purposes. One was to provide information to the Zerg for free, so that the Zerg could kill more enemies and avenge the Niu people.

The second was to hope that when the Zerg seized the spoils of the alien race and found items that the Niu tribe needed, the Zerg would give priority to trading with the Niu tribe.

Wu Qing also found several temporarily added pictures in the information provided by Niu Chong, which were the things that the Niu tribe wanted to find back.

Regardless of Niu Zhong's ultimate goal, Wu Qing originally wanted to receive enough information and prepare to seize a piece of land outside the main city first.

He loaded the Zerg worker bees in the transport host to build a Zerg base here.

Only when the Zerg base is built can it get rid of the limitations of the goblin space transmission channel and continuously provide enough troops for the Zerg army.

Once the Zerg mother nest is upgraded to six stars, the Zerg mother nest can evolve to the next form, and then the Zerg space transmission building can be built, truly realizing the space connection between Zerg territories.

The Zerg base must not be built within the scope of the main city. Cities outside the main city are the best choice.

The 66th city in the 108th area of the public battlefield in the southern theater originally controlled by the Niu tribe meets Wu Qing's requirements in some aspects.

It is located in the middle line area of the battlefield, and is about the same distance from the main cities of the local camp and the evil god camp. It is considered the central area of this battlefield.

If you want to run a business, there will be a large number of local camps of various races who need to enter the city to rest and replenish supplies. If you want to go out of the city to fight, the army of the evil god camp is right in front of the door.

The place where the city is located is backed by a mountain, and it is an easy-to-defend and difficult-to-attack place.

If the alien human army was not too strong, a large number of local camp troops would have gone to seize it.

In Wu Qing's view, this city is far away from the main cities of both sides, which is conducive to the secret development of the Zerg. Backed by the mountains, it can better build the Zerg underground base.

Located in the central area of the entire battlefield, the Zerg can better radiate and influence the surrounding areas, which is conducive to the future development of the Zerg.

Now with the various information provided by Niu Zhong, this 66th city is indeed a good choice for the Zerg.

"No problem! Rest for a day today, replenish some troops, and we will set off tomorrow to the 66th city!"

"If you are interested, you can come with us. When the spoils are found, you can just take what you need!"

Wu Qing agreed to Niu Zhong's proposal and decided to set off tomorrow to the 66th city.

The Zerg army does not have enough troops, and some troops need to be dispatched from the Zerg territory.

As for inviting Niu Zhong, it is a reward for Niu Zhong's free information.

"Thank you for the invitation! Tomorrow our army will come on time to lead the Zerg army!"

Niu Zhong was very happy to be invited by Wu Qing to accompany him, and said that he would lead the army to lead the Zerg army tomorrow.

Not only can he see the Zerg army slaughtering the enemy, but he also has the opportunity to take back the things of the tribe.

Under Wu Qing's guidance, the two chatted about some other topics. Wu Qing learned that although the cattle tribe did not obtain the status of a large tribe in the local camp, it could be regarded as one of the top races under the large tribes.

The cattle tribe is widely distributed, with a large number of tribesmen, and the main power of the tribe is concentrated in the north.

The tribe that Niu Chong belongs to is a branch of the cattle tribe in the southern region. They entered the public battlefield in the southern war zone not for the improvement of the status of the race, but purely for the development needs of their branch.

If a race wants to develop, it cannot be trapped in the hinterland of the local camp's sphere of influence. In the relatively safe hinterland, large-scale wars rarely occur. If you want to develop in a regular way, it takes a lot of time to accumulate.

Ordinary races, even if they go to the battlefield of the camp war, can only be allocated some useless defense areas.

Either there is no enemy for a long time, which is no different from the hinterland; or the war is too frequent, and the dangerous place cannot be defended even if the race's foundation is exhausted.

Therefore, many races that meet the conditions will apply to go to the public battlefield, enter the public battlefield, fight as they want, and develop as they please as long as they don't care about the evaluation of the big tribes.

This is the case with the tribe that Niu Zhong belongs to. They are not weak in themselves. They were originally doing well here, but because of the strong participation of the alien race, they were instantly defeated.

The situation of the Niu tribe is still good. There is a strong backing of the main tribe behind them, and there are many tribesmen, and there is still a chance to make a comeback.

Many ordinary races, after such a blow, have no chance to turn over, and there are even many who are exterminated because of this.

…

Wu Qing and Niu Zhong had a very enjoyable chat. Through Niu Zhong, the local snake, Wu Qing obtained a lot of useful information, which can be regarded as Niu Zhong's disguised friendship with the Zerg.

After Niu Zhong said goodbye and left, Wu Qing did not return to the meeting place presided over by the Queen of Zerg. He went directly back to the loading space of the transport host.

Wu Qing's consciousness returned to the main body.

He first hatched a group of Sky Silkworm Knights and transported a group of Zerg Energy Coins to Mengzhong City. The Zerg needed to trade a group of Qiyunzhu with the Goblins.

The Zerg won a great victory and immediately had a large number of Zerg Energy Coins, which could stimulate the Goblins' enthusiasm to help the Zerg.

After the Sky Silkworm Knights transported the Zerg Energy Coins, they would go through the Goblins' space transmission channel to the main city of the 108th District of the Southern Theater Public Battlefield and station in the large station given to the Zerg by the Goblins.

In Wu Qing's opinion, sending some Sky Silkworm Knights to the main city with a large population to spread the Sky Silkworm Nine Transformations, publicize the reputation of the Zerg, and cooperate with the performance of the Zerg army on the battlefield should have a good effect.

By the way, they are responsible for communicating with the Goblins and garrisoning the Zerg station. Once the Zerg army leaves the main city, it will definitely not go back easily.

When the Zerg army takes over the territory and builds a Zerg base, the Zerg army will not return to the main city even more.

So Wu Qing gave the main city's garrison to the Silkworm Knights, and let them develop and grow in the main city based on this.

Wu Qing also upgraded all the idle Zerg troops in the Zerg territory according to the standards given by the Naga tribe, with 10,000 troops, and deployed them in the proportion of 8,000 one-star, 1,800 two-star, 180 three-star and 20 four-star.

There are a total of 200,000 Zerg Hydralisks, 50,000 Zerg Dragons and 100,000 Zerg Cockroaches.

In addition, 100 Zerg Queens and 100 Zerg Blasting Swarms were hatched. Wu Qing felt that the original 100 Zerg Queens were still too few, so he added another 100.

Because the power of the Zerg Blasting Swarm was too strong at five stars, it caused fear among other races, so only 100 were sent.

These two types of troops will not be upgraded for the time being. When they are needed, they can be upgraded to the corresponding star level at any time.
